notes.title: Bugfix patch
notes.notes:
*Fixed multiple achievements being unobtainable
*Fixed Guardy Pose not guarding
*Fixed Fruitium Miner dialogue and awards

Sorry about the delay! Please let me know if something is still not working properly, and I'll have a look at it.

notes.title: Celia's Quest officially released on Steam
notes.notes: Celia's Quest is now, finally, released on Steam! Thank you so much to everyone who helped the game get this far, and please do have fun experiencing Celia's first adventure firsthand!
